stories.title: Sources: Eagles QB Hurts, out indefinitely with blood clot, not planned for IR
stories.summary: The Eagles are not planning to put Jalen Hurts on injured reserve, sources told ESPN, even as he remains sidelined indefinitely with a superficial blood clot.

stories.title: Sources: Florida QB Jones to start vs. Texas, tasked with ending 2-game slide
stories.summary: Florida will start Tramell Jones Jr. at quarterback against Texas, sources told ESPN, as Aaron Philo's availability to serve as an emergency backup will be determined during warmups.

stories.title: Source: Patriots likely to activate WR Brown for Sunday's game vs. Jets
stories.summary: Patriots wide receiver A.J. Brown is likely to be activated after missing the past four games with a right high ankle sprain, a source told NFL Network's Ian Rapoport.

stories.title: Embiid adamant no one will 'take a back seat' on star-laden Sixers
stories.summary: Without VJ Edgecombe, who was held out of Friday night's 125-120 loss to the Celtics, 76ers coach Nick Nurse gave the closest glimpse of what his team may look like this season, including LeBron James and Joel Embiid playing preseason highs in minutes.

stories.title: No. 1 pick Dybantsa to have ankle checked after leaving preseason finale
stories.summary: First overall pick AJ Dybantsa exited the Wizards' preseason finale after injuring his ankle on an awkward landing and will undergo further evaluation.
